Apple renders a real NavigationSplitView (two panes = two columns, three = three; iOS 17+/macOS 14+ bridge value= to preferredCompactColumn so a non-empty selection pushes the detail on compact and the platform Back pop clears it + fires on:change). Android renders the plan's list-detail shape with Compose (:render SplitElement) — compact stack push, medium pinned pair + overlay sidebar, expanded all-pane row with the M3 readable margin. Web plans from the CONTAINER width via ResizeObserver (collapseAt/expandAt are live attributes) and adds draggable hairline dividers on fine pointers; native delegates the compact/regular switch to the platform split host, per system-defaults.md — the same division as <tabs>.
